We just crossed $100M in ARR with the River API just 5 months after releasing it and are on track to surpass $200M ARR this year.

A huge thank you to all of our customers, in particular @perplexity_ai who helped as an early design partner. The River API is the only system out there that scales to frontier level RL training runs out of the box.

Also huge thanks to @JensenHuang, @htaneja and everyone else who believed in us early on.

We’ve got a few more big announcements coming up this year, stay tuned!
